extract: Winterspring (also known as Winterspring Valley) is a snowy valley located in Northern Kalimdor, east of Felwood, northeast of Mount Hyjal, and north of Azshara. It holds the goblin trading post of Everlook, old night elf ruins, and the vast cave Mazthoril, the primary home of the blue dragonflight on Kalimdor. Many wild creatures roam this beautiful landscape.

{{Combat}} [[Ban'Thallow Barrow Den]] | affiliation = [[Wintersaber Trainers]], [[Darnassus (faction)|Darnassus]], [[Explorers' League]],[[Jaron Stoneshaper]] [[Alliance]], [[Furbolg|Furbolg tribes]], [[Blue dragonflight]], [[Steamwheedle Cartel]] | loc = Northeastern [[Northern Kalimdor]] | territory = Contested }} {{QuoteWiki|These cold and vast lands may seem dismal, but this is a place of many secrets...|[[Donova Snowden]]}} '''Winterspring''' (also known as '''Winterspring Valley''')[[:File:WC3-N04.jpg|The Druids Arise image description]] is a snowy valley located in [[Northern Kalimdor]], east of [[Felwood]], northeast of [[Mount Hyjal]], and north of [[Azshara]]. It holds the [[goblin]] trading post of [[Everlook]], old [[night elf]] ruins, and the vast cave [[Mazthoril]], the primary home of the [[blue dragonflight]] on [[Kalimdor]]. Many wild creatures roam this beautiful landscape. ==History== {{Stub/Lore-section|World of Warcraft & Cataclysm questlines}} ===Ancient times=== [[File:The Ruins of Kel'Theril.jpg|thumb|The [[Ruins of Kel'Theril]] near [[Lake Kel'Theril]].]] Long ago, Winterspring was a home for many [[blue dragon]]s, including [[Haleh]], the consort of the [[Dragon Aspect]] [[Malygos]].[[Artifacts Abound]] 10,000 years ago, the city of [[Ruins of Kel'Theril|Kel'Theril]] was located here. The [[Highborne]] who inhabited the city stole the [[:Crystal of Zin-Malor]] from the [[Temple of Zin-Malor|temple]] in [[Ruins of Eldarath|Eldarath]], but when they toyed with its tempting power its shattering cursed them all. Kel'Theril suffered until the [[Great Sundering]] destroyed it for good, and now the dead wander as ghosts.[[Pride of the Highborne]] Around 100 [[BDP]], a group of [[High elf|high elves]] led by [[Archmage Maenius]] left [[Quel'Thalas]] and traveled to Winterspring in order to obtain the [[:Crystal of Zin-Malor]]. They eventually found its shards, but like the [[Highborne]] millennia before, they were driven to madness by the artifact, somehow died, and began to wander the [[Ruins of Kel'Theril]] as [[ghost]]s.[[Legacy of the High Elves]] ===Third War=== {{WC3-section}} During the [[Third War]] in 20 [[ADP]], the [[Horde|New Horde]], [[Human Expedition]], [[Scourge]], [[Sentinels]], and the [[Corrupted Ancients|corrupted satyrs]] made camps here. [[Tyrande Whisperwind]] and [[Malfurion Stormrage]] eventually destroyed a human camp and the satyrs in the area, then awakened the [[Druids of the Talon]] in the [[Barrow Dens (Winterspring)|Winterspring's Barrow Dens]]. At the same time, a [[death revenant]] cursed a glade, raising [[skeleton]]s and [[ghost]]s in the area. Both leaders and their Sentinels defeated him and recovered the glade.[[The Druids Arise (WC3 NightElf)]] ===World of Warcraft=== {{wow-section}} [[File:Everlook.jpg|thumb|[[Everlook]], the [[goblin]] trading post of Winterspring.]] In Year 25 ADP, [[Alliance]] and [[Horde]] [[adventurer]]s trekked Winterspring, helping the citizens of [[Everlook]], [[Starfall Village]], and other settlements. Later, the [[elemental]]s [[Elemental Invasions (Classic)‎|invaded]] the region, only to be repelled by the Alliance and Horde adventurers. ===The Burning Crusade=== {{bc-section}} Prior to the [[invasion of Outland]] in 26 ADP, Winterspring was invaded by a group of [[Burning Legion]] [[demon]]s led by [[Highlord Kruul]].[[Dark Portal Opens]] ===Wrath of the Lich King=== {{wotlk-section}} Winterspring was [[Scourge Invasion|invaded]] twice by the [[Scourge]] [[undead]] in the years leading to the [[war against the Lich King]] in 27 ADP.[[Argent Emissary#Quotes]] ===Cataclysm=== {{cata-section}} [[File:Frostwhisper Gorge Cataclysm.jpg|thumb|The [[Frostwhisper Gorge]] after the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]].]] One year before the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]] in 28 ADP, the [[Blood elf|blood elves]] of [[Quel'Thalas (kingdom)|Quel'Thalas]] sought the [[:Crystal of Zin-Malor]] as their ancestors had, only to be cursed and transformed into [[wretched]].[[Pain of the Blood Elves]] A hunting party has set up camp in the northern foothills, and the bridge to [[Darkwhisper Gorge]] has been destroyed. ===Dragonflight=== {{Df-section}} By the Year 40 ADP, the [[blue dragon]] [[Haleh]] had been dutifully working towards clearing Winterspring of its myriad issues, having found dozens of cursed or otherwise harmfully enchanted artifacts in the region.[[Artifacts Abound]] After she received help from the [[adventurer]]s and the [[Sindragosa (simulacrum)|simulacrum of Sindragosa]], Haleh agreed to help the [[Dragon Aspect]] [[Kalecgos]] in reuniting the [[blue dragonflight]] on the [[Dragon Isles]],[[Back with the Blues]] claiming she still intended to make Winterspring safe for their people.[[A Wyrm Rest]] ==Getting there== Winterspring can be accessed through [[Timbermaw Hold]]. To reach Winterspring, head through the hold entrance in the northeastern tip of [[Felwood]] and continue straight after the bridge. It used to be that, in order to pass through the hold without the Timbermaw Furbolgs attacking you, you would need to have reached at least unfriendly reputation with the Timbermaw [[furbolg]]s. There are several quests in [[Felwood]] which can be completed to raise reputation with them. This is no longer necessary and Timbermaw mobs are unfriendly but will not attack. ==Geography== Both the [[Steamwheedle Cartel]] and the [[Night elf|night elves]] have established bases in the region. Though there are no instanced dungeons or battlegrounds in Winterspring, there are several [[Dungeon|micro dungeons]] in the area. ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-Winterspring.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Winterspring.]] [[File:WorldMap-Winterspring-old.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Winterspring prior to ''[[World of Warcraft: Cataclysm|Cataclysm]]''.]] {| class="darktable hlist" | *[[Beryl Egress]] *[[Caverns of Consumption]] *{{replaced|Darkwhisper Gorge}} *[[Dun Mandarr]] *[[Everlook]] **[[Laughing Yeti|The Laughing Yeti]] *[[Frostfire Hot Springs]] *[[Frostsaber Rock]] *[[Frostwhisper Gorge]] *[[Goodgrub Smoking Pit]] *[[Great Sea|The Great Sea]] *[[Hidden Grove|The Hidden Grove]] *[[Ice Thistle Hills]] *[[Lake Kel'Theril]] **[[Ruins of Kel'Theril|The Ruins of Kel'Theril]] *[[Mazthoril]] *[[Moon Horror Den]] *[[Owl Wing Thicket]] *[[Snowden Chalet]] *[[Starfall Village]] **[[Ban'Thallow Barrow Den]] *[[Timbermaw Hold]] *[[Timbermaw Post]] *[[Winterfall Village]] |- || ---- ;{{WC3-inline}} [[Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos|Warcraft III]] *[[Barrow Dens (Winterspring)|Barrow Dens]] *[[Cursed Glade]] *[[Nendis]] (speculated) |} {{clear|left}} ===Travel hubs=== [[File:Starfall Village.jpg|thumb|[[Starfall Village]]]] ===={{Alliance}}{{Horde}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Everlook]]==== *{{Horde}}[[Orgrimmar]], [[Durotar]] *{{Horde}}[[Bilgewater Harbor]], [[Azshara]] *{{Alliance}}[[Talonbranch Glade]], [[Felwood]] *{{Horde}}[[Irontree Clearing]], [[Felwood]] *{{Alliance}}{{Horde}} [[Moonglade]] *{{Neutral}}[[Nordrassil]], [[Mount Hyjal]] {{cata-inline}} ===Regions adjacent to Winterspring=== {| class="darktable" |- ! Throughout their progression through the zone, players go from fighting the [[Winterfall tribe]] at the request of [[Donova Snowden]], to studying [[Highborne]] spirits at [[Lake Kel'Theril]], to game hunting from [[Everlook]] and the [[Goodgrub Smoking Pit]], to helping the [[blue dragonflight]] exiles at [[Mazthoril]] reclaim their home. ==Resources== [[File:Mazthoril.jpg|thumb|[[Mazthoril]]]] *[[Herb]]s **[[Mountain Silversage]] **[[Icecap]] (Winterspring is the only region you can gather it.) **[[Black Lotus]] (One of the few regions where you can gather it. Rare.) *[[Leather]] **[[Thick Leather]] **[[Rugged Leather]] **[[Worn Dragonscale]] (Skinning [[Azurous]] or [[General Cobaltann]]]) **[[Warbear Leather]] (Skinning level 50-55 [[bear]]s) **[[Blue Dragonscale]] (Skinning [[Azurous]] or [[General Cobaltann]]) *[[Ore]] **[[Truesilver Ore]] **[[Thorium Ore]] ==Wild creatures== [[File:Frostsaber Rock.jpg|thumb|[[Frostsaber Rock]]]] *{{RaceIcon|Bear}} [[Bear]]s *{{RaceIcon|Chimaera}} [[Chimaera]] *{{Race|Dark troll}}s{{WC3-inline}} *{{RaceIcon|Deer}} [[Deer]][[The Druids Arise]]{{WC3-inline}} *{{RaceIcon|Wintersaber}} [[Frostsaber]]s *{{RaceIcon|Ghost}} [[Ghost]]s *{{RaceIcon|Owl}} [[Owl]]s *{{Race|Satyr}}{{WC3-inline}} *{{RaceIcon|ThunderLizard}} [[Thunder lizard]]s{{WC3-inline}} *{{Race|Wildkin}} *{{RaceIcon|Wolf}} [[Wolf|Wolves]] *{{Race|Yeti}}s ==In the RPG== {{RPG-section}} '''Winterspring''' (also known as '''Winterspring Valley'''''[[World of Warcraft: The Roleplaying Game]]'', pg. 19 or '''Winterspring Grove''')''[[World of Warcraft: The Roleplaying Game]]'', pg. 203 is a frozen land covered in snow similar to [[Dun Morogh]]. While most [[Night elf|night elves]] find the land less hospitable than the nearby forests, a number of elves reside there for two main reasons: first, it is in close proximity to [[Mount Hyjal]]; and second, its mysterious hot springs may be connected to [[demon]] activity. Winterspring's perpetual cold is natural enough, and it is the closest area to Mount Hyjal's summit.''[[Lands of Mystery]]'', pg. 23 This valley has long been involved in a struggle between malevolent [[blue dragon]]s and the fearsome white [[frostsaber]] cats.''[[Warcraft: The Roleplaying Game]]'', pg. 212 Home of [[dragon]]s, [[goblin]]s and filthy [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Irons]], there's a lot to be done in this frozen tundra.''[[Lands of Mystery]]'', pg. 26 ===History=== The ancient ruins in Winterspring are evidence of the scars left by the [[Great Sundering|Sundering]]. Once hinterlands, the entire eastern expanse was ripped away during the Sundering, leaving a sprawling coastline. Thousands of years ago, this valley upon the slopes of Mount Hyjal served as a place for the night elves to start anew in the wake of the Sundering.''[[Warcraft: The Roleplaying Game]]'', pg. 211 - 212 It was also here, long ago, that [[dragons]] took up residence to watch over neighboring Hyjal and the nearby [[World Tree]] [[Nordrassil]]. The [[blue dragonflight]] keeps its vigil here, whereas most of the other [[dragonflight]]s have moved to the base of the World Tree or other locations. The recent success of [[Everlook]] has brought more adventurers into Winterspring, which the natives hope will aid them in defeating the threat of the demons of [[Darkwhisper Gorge]]. This otherwise cold and serene place shakes with periodic conflict between the forces of the sorcerer-dragon [[General Colbatann|Cobaltann]] and the night elves who strive to drive them from the slopes of Mount Hyjal. The [[goblin]]s of Everlook recently discovered a new mine to the south of their city, not far from the dragon caves of [[Mazthoril]]. This mine is valuable due to a large amount of [[arcanite]] within it, but thus far it proves inaccessible. While not part of the blue dragon's cave complex, the dragons are territorial, and so the goblins are looking for a hero that can find a way to convince the blue dragonflight to allow them access to the mine, in exchange of a nice reward of course. ===Geography=== Winterspring lies to the east of [[Felwood]] and [[Moonglade]], and to the northeast of [[Hyjal Summit]]. The easiest access to any of these locations on foot is through the caves of the [[Timbermaw tribe|Timbermaw]] [[furbolg]]s, although Everlook offers flying mounts that travel to Felwood or Moonglade — for a price. Winterspring Valley is above [[Moonglade]] and is the last stop along the road that winds up to Hyjal Peak. The valley is separated from Moonglade, lower on the mountain slope, by a thick, white cloud bank. Once above the clouds, the air is crisp and clean and the sun shines often when the snow is not falling. The trees of Winterspring were bent and twisted into odd positions during the climactic [[Battle of Mount Hyjal]]. Many of the World Tree's massive roots are also exposed here, towering overhead like massive oak archways. Only three major humanoid settlements exist in this region: the night elven village of [[Starfall Village|Starfall]], and more interestingly, the goblin town of [[Everlook]]. The third is [[Mazthoril]], home of [[Kalimdor]]'s blue dragonflight. Everlook is located on the far east side of Winterspring, near the center, and Starfall Village is slightly to the northwest.''[[Lands of Mystery]]'', pg. 24 Several creatures live in the icy terrain, such as [[chimera]]s, [[polar bear]]s, and the rare and legendary [[frostsaber cat]]s. Almost all of the animals here are vicious and dangerous predators. These animals are only rarely seen due to the high altitude. It is a place of cold medium forest and rugged mountains. ==Notes== *[[Darkwhisper Gorge]] formerly occupied a rather large portion of the zone. It held elite demons of an approximate five-man difficulty who have guarded a non-functional entrance to [[Mount Hyjal]]. When the ''Cataclysm'' expansion was released, the subzone was merged with the Hyjal zone. However, the edge of the mountain drop between Darkwhisper Gorge in Hyjal and [[Azshara]] is still considered part of Winterspring, and players briefly enter and exit Winterspring when flying between Hyjal and Azshara. *Prior to ''[[World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King|Wrath of the Lich King]]'', [[Blizzard Entertainment|Blizzard]] sometimes used footage of Winterspring as a stand-in for the continent of [[Northrend]] (such as in the [[Shadow of the Necropolis trailer]] and the portals in [[Kel'Thuzad's Chamber]] in [[Naxxramas]]). ==Gallery== ;''World of Warcraft'' File:Beryl Egress.jpg|[[Beryl Egress]] File:Dun Mandarr.jpg|[[Dun Mandarr]] File:Frostfire Hot Springs.jpg|[[Frostfire Hot Springs]] File:Goodgrub Smoking Pit.jpg|[[Goodgrub Smoking Pit]] File:The Hidden Grove.jpg|[[Hidden Grove]] File:Ice Thistle Hills.jpg|[[Ice Thistle Hills]] File:Moon Horror Den.jpg|[[Moon Horror Den]] File:Owl Wing Thicket.jpg|[[Owl Wing Thicket]] File:Timbermaw Post.jpg|[[Timbermaw Post]] File:Winterfall Village.jpg|[[Winterfall Village]] File:Lake Kel'Theril.jpg|[[Lake Kel'Theril]] File:Kalimdor early layout.jpg|Early layout of Kalimdor with Winterspring in a different location. ;''[[Warcraft III]]'' File:WC3-N04.jpg|Winterspring location on the ''Warcraft III'' map.
